lead: Today’s signal: Design is becoming AI’s most important interface

items.title: Designing for the edges improves the center
items.summary: When products work for people with the most constraints, they tend to work better for everyone.
items.why: 包容性设计不仅解决边缘用户的问题，也能让所有人的使用体验更清晰。

items.title: What should the future look like? Inside the tech-funded program to create a new aesthetic
items.summary: A program exploring what a new visual language for the 21st century could look like.
items.why: 观察科技、资本与审美如何共同塑造未来产品的视觉语言。

items.title: Design history, as told through 125 objects
items.summary: Cooper Hewitt uses 125 objects to connect design history with contemporary practice.
items.why: 从经典案例中理解形式、材料和用户需求如何随时代变化。

items.title: Introducing Astra for Law
items.summary: A legal AI workspace combining frontier models, connected data and firm-specific workflows.
items.why: 专业工具的机会正在从聊天窗口转向完整、可信的工作流设计。

items.title: Helping older adults use AI in everyday life
items.summary: Hands-on workshops help older adults build practical AI skills safely.
items.why: 适老化设计会成为 AI 产品可用性与信任设计的重要试验场。

items.title: Basedash Models
items.summary: Define a reusable model once, then query it like a table.
items.why: 关注它如何把复杂的数据结构转化为更容易理解和操作的界面。

items.title: People thought this MLB hat had a defect. It’s actually a clever hidden reference
items.summary: A seemingly broken graphic becomes a memorable piece of visual storytelling.
items.why: 一个微小的视觉细节如何承载文化记忆，是品牌设计的好案例。

items.title: Steam Frame
items.summary: A wearable PC concept for accessing a Steam library.
items.why: 新硬件形态会迫使交互设计重新思考屏幕、输入与使用场景。

weekly.note: 每周一更新：汇总上周最重要的设计、AI 与产品变化。

monthly.note: 每月第一天更新：提炼上月值得长期关注的趋势。
